shots.text: A road is cut into the wall of the Rift. It took us a day to walk down it. At the bottom we went through the gap in the Black Gate one at a time, the way his armies had come out.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: The army winding down the Rift road in a long line of lanterns; at the bottom, soldiers filing through the cart-wide gap in the colossal Gate.

shots.text: Behind the Gate is the Hollow, a cavern under the world so big its roof is lost in the dark. The only light is grey fire. A day's march in stood his fortress, Nhal Vorath, built from the ruins of his old city, which sank with him.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: The Hollow: a stone sky, grey fires, and on a broken plain a vast black fortress built of ancient ruined walls, towers and gates.

shots.text: His army was still too big to storm. So we dug in in front of his walls, built our towers, and let it come to us.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: The Concord's camp on the broken ground before the fortress; Spirewright towers going up.

shots.text:
You built your city on my city, and you lock my door with my own crown.

Come in, then.
shots.speaker: vael_orrun
shots.art_note: The fortress gates; a huge shape in the dark above them. Every colour on screen drains to grey for a moment.

shots.text: For once we're not holding a road, Spirewright. We're on his.
shots.speaker: tamsin
shots.art_note: Tamsin, lantern-pole raised, at the head of the camp.
